## Runs 6 and 7 — spot cuts reviewed before the Landau fan (plan step 3)

Both completed: data/6 has 921 points over 0–10 T (120.3 min); data/7 has 486 points over 10–0.3 T (95.6 min). Measured drain current spans 9.81–9.94 nA; signed B_1–B_2 resistance spans −33 to 530 ohm (electron) and −0.38 to 587 ohm (hole), without clipping. Raw voltage precedes current-normalized resistance and Fourier analysis below. Preserve signed resistance: rectifying its zero crossings would manufacture harmonics.

Electron FFT peaks near 7 and 30 T persist across 1.5–10 and 2–10 T windows; intermediate peaks near 14 and 22 T may be harmonics. Hole peaks near 5–7 and 12 T are window-dependent. The onset helper reports a censored low-edge tone at 0.5 T, not a measured onset; its near-residual and harmonic flags prevent reading every returned tone as a band. No stacking assignment follows from these spectra. The next fan (plan step 4) tests continuous branch dispersion and origins across both carrier signs. Nominal n and D retain absolute-scale and D-zero uncertainty from run 5; two CNP ridges are not proof of separately resolved spatial domains.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
root = Path.cwd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(14, 7))
for j, rid in enumerate([6,7]):
 r = open_run(root/'data'/str(rid)); ch = resolve_channels(r.meta); ic = current_channel(ch); vc = next(c for c in ch if c.cid=='sr1')
 B=r.col('magnet_field'); I=r.col(ic.col)/ic.gain; V=r.col(vc.col)/vc.gain; R=V/I
 order=np.argsort(B); B=B[order]; R=R[order]
 print('RUN',rid,'rows',r.rows,'interrupted',r.interrupted,'elapsed_min',(r.data[-1,0]-r.data[0,0])/60,'columns',r.cols)
 print('current_nA',np.min(I)*1e9,np.max(I)*1e9,'signed R',np.min(R),np.max(R),'metadata',r.meta['measurement_config'])
 ax[j,0].plot(r.col('magnet_field'),V*1e6); ax[j,0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='raw sr1 X (uV)',title=f'Run {rid}: raw voltage')
 ax[j,1].plot(B,R); ax[j,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='signed V/I (ohm)',title='Measured-current normalization')
 for lo in [1.5,2,3]:
  f,a=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),bg_degree=3,log=False,nfft=2048)
  a=a[0]; pk,_=find_peaks(a); pk=sorted([p for p in pk if 3<f[p]<65],key=lambda p:-a[p])[:5]
  print('FFT',lo,[(round(f[p],2),round(a[p],1)) for p in pk], 'resolution',1/(1/lo-.1))
  ax[j,2].plot(f,a/a.max(),label=f'{lo}-10 T')
 try:
  o=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=0.5,r_full_scale=5000,bg_degree=3); print(o.summary())
 except Exception as e: print('onset unresolved:',e)
 ax[j,2].set(xlim=(0,65),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT',title='Window dependence; no stacking assignment'); ax[j,2].legend()
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(root/'hera_scratch/spot_review.png',dpi=140); plt.show()
for rid in [5,6,7]:
 r=open_run(root/'data'/str(rid)); dt=np.diff(r.data[:,0]); print('TIMING',rid,'median_dt',np.median(dt),'p90',np.quantile(dt,.9),'elapsed',(r.data[-1,0]-r.data[0,0])/60)

## HERA — Landau fan across both carrier signs (plan step 4)

> **05:22** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: inferred D=0, n\* -1.2..+3.2e12 (111); B=0 then 1.5..10 T (101 uniform-1/B rows); base T, Si=0, 3 s dwell · **ETA ~17:22** (≈12h)

Runs 6 and 7 are complete and show usable field-dependent structure on B_1–B_2, with 9.81–9.94 nA drain current and no clipping. Their Fourier peaks are not uniquely band counts (electron ~7/~30 T, with potential harmonics; hole ~5–7/~12 T). Measure how branches disperse with density and whether they share or have shifted origins; this is the next discrimination step for ABAB/ABCA/ABCB, not a preselected stacking call. Raw signed voltage/current maps precede FFT or derivative analysis. Only B_1–B_2 is measured; two CNP ridges do not by themselves resolve two spatial regions.

Use the run-5 calibrated gate ratio 0.772765, with Ctg=2.79606 mF/m² still geometry-anchored, n-offset −0.08938×10¹² cm⁻², and operational D-offset −0.013 V/nm. Co-sweep TG/BG at inferred D=0, nominal n* −1.2 to +3.2×10¹² cm⁻² (111 points, Δn*=0.04); retain gate-space axes until LL counting establishes an absolute lever arm. Take B=0 baseline, then 101 rows from 1.5 to 10 T uniformly in 1/B. Δ(1/B)=0.005667 T⁻¹ gives ~5.9 samples/period at 30 T and Fourier resolution ~1.76 T over the finite-field span; at 1.5 T, a fourfold LL spans ~0.145×10¹² cm⁻² (~3.6 gate points). High-field B spacing grows to ~0.54 T: narrow crossings remain a follow-up target. 3 s point dwell is 10τ at the operator's 0.3 s/24 dB settings. Fixed sr1 sensitivity 100 µV (10 kΩ nominal full-scale) retains headroom near CNP; sr0 stays 20 mV. Every acquired channel is plotted live, including phases, gate leakage, temperatures, and field/gate readbacks.

Coverage trade: both carrier signs inside the established D=0 window, excluding the tiny edge strips n* −1.27..−1.2 and +3.2..+3.27; no D dependence or density-dependent low-B fan below 1.5 T. The existing spots cover low B; adding 0.5–1.5 T at this inverse-field spacing costs ~26 h with this full gate grid. Larger density coverage would require a different D path or forbidden limit extension. Price: 10 T/(1/7.3 T/min)=73 min ramp floor; run 6 measured 7.46 s per 10 mT, implying ~3.08 s field overhead/set. Run 5 measured 1.10 s/point at 1 s dwell and NPLC=1; budget 3.2 s/point here for two moving gates and extra readbacks. 11,322 points give 604 min; ~10 s gate flyback +3 s slow delay +3.1 s magnet settle per 102 rows adds 27 min; ramp and setup bring the estimate to ~705 min, rounded to 12 h. No return ramp is included: end at 10 T for a possible descending follow-up.

Preflight prints actual versus expected state, asserts exact committed validators, gate pacing, base thermometry freshness, both heater ranges off, Si=0/RNGE2/output on, fixed wiring, drive, time constants, and NPLC. No validator, pacing, heater or Si setting changes. First checkpoint: baseline row and first two finite-B rows (~40 min including initial 1.5 T ramp); inspect initial points earlier via the live monitor. Then inspect hera-watch every ~45 min and analyze complete rows at B≈3 T. Abort on leakage, clipping, current loss or state mismatch; do not spend the remaining run on flat/noisy data if branch contrast is absent. Two consecutive points above 1 nA gate current, below 8 nA drain current, or above 90% lock-in full scale request a sweep stop; temperature/readback mismatches stop immediately. Kernel interrupt does not stop this magnet supply: it continues to its bounded current target; read actual field before any next move. Monitor is armed before execution.

# Plan step 4 — both-carrier Landau fan; no safety or pacing changes.
import json
from pathlib import Path

# Read assumed state before any write.
for name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
Ts, Tv, B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
si0 = k_si()
ranges = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
print(f'Expected base Ts 1.0..1.5 K, Tv<1.6 K, |B|<0.02 T, Si=0, heaters off; actual {Ts=}, {Tv=}, {B0=}, {si0=}, {ranges=}')
assert 1.0 <= Ts <= 1.5 and 0 < Tv < 1.6 and abs(Tv-Ts)<0.6
assert abs(B0)<0.02 and abs(si0)<0.01 and ranges==(0,0)
ps, output = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
print('Expected PS/output on; actual', ps, output)
assert ps and output and not magnet.is_ramping()
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
for param, bounds in [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
                      (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
                      (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
                      (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    actual=(float(param.vals._min_value),float(param.vals._max_value))
    print(param.full_name,'expected validator',bounds,'actual',actual)
    assert actual==bounds
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10 and T_SESSION_CAP==100
print('Pacing expected TG/BG step 0.005 V, Si 0.5 V/s; actual',k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step,dc205.ramp_rate)
assert k_tg.volt.step==0.005 and k_bg.volt.step==0.005 and dc205.ramp_rate==0.5
assert dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
amp, freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
print('Expected drive 1 V / 13.777 Hz; actual',amp,freq)
assert abs(amp-1.)<1e-6 and abs(freq-13.777)<0.01
for inst in (sr0,sr1):
    tau,slope=inst.time_constant(),inst.filter_slope()
    print(inst.name,'expected tau 0.3 s / slope 24 dB; actual',tau,slope)
    assert tau==0.3 and slope==24
print('Expected NPLC 1/1; actual',k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config.get('sr1_gain',1)==1
assert meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1'

# Explicit SI inversion of session run-5 calibration; n* scale remains prior-anchored.
fc = json.loads((Path(main_dir)/'hera_scratch'/'cal_run5.json').read_text())
assert fc['run']==5 and abs(fc['ratio']-0.7727648902821315)<1e-9
n_star=np.linspace(-1.2,3.2,111)
charge=(n_star-fc['n_offset'])*1e16*cst.e
imbalance=(0.-fc['D_offset'])*1e9*2*cst.epsilon_0
fan_tg=(charge+imbalance)/(2*fc['c_tg'])
fan_bg=(charge-imbalance)/(2*fc['c_bg'])
fan_B=np.r_[0.,field_invB(1.5,10.,101)]
for param,vec in [(k_tg.volt,fan_tg),(k_bg.volt,fan_bg),(magnet.field,fan_B)]:
    for value in vec: param.validate(float(value))
    print(param.full_name,'planned min/max',float(vec.min()),float(vec.max()),'points',len(vec))
# Fixed 100 uV sensitivity protects CNP over the full density line (run 5).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
assert sr1.sensitivity()==100e-6 and sr0.sensitivity()==0.02
mc=dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'Si (V)':si0,'sample_temperature:':Ts,'fan_calibration':fc,
           'nominal_density_units':'1e12 cm^-2; absolute scale geometry prior',
           'sr1_gain':1.,'sr0_tau':0.3,'sr1_tau':0.3,'filter_slope_dB':24,
           'comments':'landau-fan; B_1-B_2; inferred D=0; n* -1.2..3.2; Si=0; base T; run-5 calibration'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc, basedir=str(Path(main_dir)/'data'))
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('Plan step 4: B=0 baseline then 1.5->10 T, 101 uniform-1/B rows; n*=-1.2..3.2 x10^12 cm^-2, 111 points; inferred D=0; Si=0 V; 3 s dwell; 100 uV sr1; absolute density and D-zero provisional')
# Raw lock-in values (gain=1): analysis applies metadata gains once.
fan_follow=[T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,magnet.field,k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt]
for p in fan_follow:
    s.fp(p)
    s.plot('time',p)
fan_index={p.full_name:4+i for i,p in enumerate(fan_follow)}
fan_count=0
fan_bad=0

def fan_before(station):
    global fan_count
    if fan_count%len(n_star)==0:
        for name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
            assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        print('Row',fan_count//len(n_star),'B actual',magnet.field(),'T',T_sample(),T_vaporizer())

def fan_after(station,data):
    global fan_count, fan_bad
    def val(p): return float(data[fan_index[p.full_name]])
    reasons=[]
    if max(abs(val(k_tg.curr)),abs(val(k_bg.curr)))>1e-9: reasons.append('gate leakage >1 nA')
    if not (1.0<=val(T_sample)<=1.5 and 0<val(T_vaporizer)<1.6): reasons.append('base temperature lost')
    if abs(val(magnet.field)-float(data[1]))>0.02: reasons.append('field mismatch >20 mT')
    if abs(val(k_tg.volt)-float(data[2]))>0.005 or abs(val(k_bg.volt)-float(data[3]))>0.005: reasons.append('gate readback mismatch')
    if abs(val(sr1.X))>0.9e-4 or abs(val(sr0.X))>0.018: reasons.append('lock-in headroom <10%')
    current=val(sr0.X)/mc['sr0_gain']
    if not 8e-9<current<12e-9: reasons.append('drain current outside 8..12 nA')
    fan_bad=fan_bad+1 if reasons else 0
    fan_count+=1
    if fan_bad>=2 or any('mismatch' in x or 'temperature' in x for x in reasons):
        print('FAN STOP:',reasons,'B target',data[1],flush=True)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_before(fan_before,())
s.register_run_after(fan_after,())
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(fan_bg[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(fan_tg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
fan_result=s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[fan_B],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[fan_tg,fan_bg],slow_delay=3.,fast_delay=3.)
print('Fan result',fan_result.id,'interrupted',fan_result.metadata.get('interrupted'))
print('Actual endpoint B/TG/BG/Si/Ts/Tv',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),k_si(),T_sample(),T_vaporizer())
# Hold endpoint for analysis; no automatic retraverse or close-out.

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
